a JUDGE ORDER line that seats one of them and a `debate_judgments` row from it.
- THE JUDGING HOLDS ONE COPY OF EACH REQUEST (ASK 611; engine: QR Merge, Panel Judges Prep, Panel Judges Parallel, Close Enforcer Build, Close Enforcer Record, Close Group Batch Build, Close Group Batch Call openrouter, Close Group Retry Build, Panel Check, Reserve Build, Alternate Pass Call, and the Shared Library; no prompt text and no rule text is changed; where it differs from any entry above in this section, this rule is right):
  - Rule: no step of the judging puts out a second whole copy of a request that carries the debate. The request is rebuilt, with the same text, where it is sent or read. What each judge and each enforcer is sent is the same as before, byte for byte.
  - The judges after the question round: QR Merge puts out the three judges without their request body. Every reader rebuilds a judge's request as the Panel Build body plus the question-round text. The readers are the Shared Library entries that rebuild each judge's full request after the question round, Send Back Build and Late Gate Build among them, Panel Check, Reserve Build, and Alternate Pass Call, whose input expression rebuilds the bodies so that the child receives what it received before.
  - The panel send: Panel Judges Prep puts out each slot without the body; Panel Judges Parallel builds the body in its request expression at the send.
  - The closing enforcer: the second copy per side that Close Enforcer Build puts out carries its temperature and no body. It is the first copy's request at that temperature, rebuilt at the send and in Close Enforcer Record for the prompt of its log rows.
  - The close group batch: Close Group Batch Build puts out the type and the index only; Close Group Batch Call openrouter fetches the body from the Build step at send time. Close Group Retry Build takes the body from Close Group Batch Build and, when that item holds none, rebuilds it from Close Enforcer Build or Assume Check Build.
  - A new reader of the QR Merge judges must use the rebuilding form. A reader that takes those judges as they are finds no body; at the send-back that gives, for each panel seat, the row "NOT SENT: no panel request for this seat", and no send-back reaches the panel.
  - An n8n expression ends at the first "}}". Code inside an expression keeps a space between two closing braces. The standing set compiles every expression of both workflows in n8n's own parser.
  - Shown offline: on the stored rows of two runs every request sent is md5-equal to the request before the change, and about 3.2 million and 2.2 million fewer characters are held in the judging. With QR Merge judges without body, Send Back Build and Late Gate Build give each judge the request it had before the change, byte-equal.
  - Limits: not shown by a clean run. A run on this rule finished with an outcome, the question round run, three verdicts and closing enforcer rows for both sides, and sent no panel send-back: Send Back Build and Late Gate Build did not then rebuild the body. Their rebuild is not shown by a run. That the lower load prevents an out-of-memory end of the judging is not shown. Close Enforcer Resume and Close Enforcer Needed? still pass the close items on, one more copy each, and the judge webhook is still sent each whole body. Marks: in a run whose question round ran, panel `send_back` rows of `debate_enforcer_log` that are sent and answered, and no row reading "NOT SENT: no panel request for this seat".
